uncertainty: Paired image bootstrap for frozen policies; calibration/selection variance and prior TEST exposure remain. No theorem guaranteeing preservation of population microF1.
test_scope: Enumerate every distinct attainable score cut on full TEST as a descriptive Pareto/oracle analysis only. Do not deploy or rename TEST-selected optima as validation choices.
common_threshold: Evaluate the same raw score cuts across all three TEST sets as an explicitly post-hoc existence check; include all-DeepSolo endpoint. Validation selects policies separately from their own paired outcomes.

scientific_choices.PAPER_SPECIFIED: Algorithm2 fallback motivation only; trained gate and accuracy/cost optimization are extensions.
scientific_choices.REPOSITORY_SPECIFIED: Same frozen30-feature Ridge, corrected U-Net chain, native YOLO expert, native256 ignore, symbol-free lexical microF1 and complete TEST denominators.
scientific_choices.ASSUMPTION: Validation paired counts use existing23-image IC13 heldout Task2.2 blank-line word groups and100-image IC15 heldout quadrilaterals, plus source TotalText CAL63. Use existing canonical Task2.2 transcription/geometry/ignore parsers; no invented word grouping or TEST split. Native YOLO confidence is an explicit feature shift.
scientific_choices.HARDWARE_DEVIATION: Sequential RTX3090 FP32 isolated expert processes and cached-output CPU threshold enumeration; no complete online latency claim.
scientific_choices.UNRESOLVED: Small validation, cross-dataset threshold transfer, historical expert/TEST exposure, external-corpus overlap, paper metric and IC13split equivalence, conditional bootstrap uncertainty.

simultaneous_bootstrap.method: Maximum centered bootstrap F1-gain error across every cutoff, paired image resampling, fixed expert outputs; approximate conditional band, no finite-sample theorem

shared_validation_cut: Enumerate common score cuts using only pooled validation inputs; choose minimum total DeepSolo subject to empirical noninferiority separately on all3 validation sets. Freeze before TEST frontier enumeration.
